LongId.description: Canonical decimal string; server also checks <=9223372036854775807. Numeric JSON is rejected.

LongValue.description: Nonnegative Java long count/size/degree; server checks <=9223372036854775807.

Scope.description: Dimensions are conjunctive. project iff arrays all empty; selected requires a nonempty dimension. Empty dimension is unconstrained. Server-issued only; stage1 uses selected libraries/documents and no node scope.

CreateRun.description: Reject unknown fields/duplicate keys/duplicate IDs. Goal is display only. Resolve selection against current server grant and real library membership; no client roles/tools/dependencies/limits/artifacts or credentials.

Graph.description: Stored research projection, never legacy neighbor fallback. Both endpoints must be original and included. Paths hold original directed edge IDs in order. No synthetic nodes or sources; null observedAt iff no graph observation.

SourceCheck.description: INVALID_POINTER can contain status only; missing identity is never fabricated.
